query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM address_utxo WHERE date in <year window> AND owner_addr IN ('addr1qyleluql6elu7sktvncqfufnq675hlt9z922ah9sm45dmp7kjn0vsay0vq28379mczjmglmam3svuxyka0tyw0uchwjqmxmhg3')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
